headline: HTDA: Afternoon Thunderstorm Risk — Dar es Salaam Ops
body: Convective outlook indicates 70% probability of TS activity 1400–1900 LT at Julius Nyerere Intl. ATR 72-600 sectors to Zanzibar (HTZA) and Kilimanjaro (HTKJ) flagged for potential holding or delays.
source: TMA Tanzania Met | Translation: Original English / Translated from Swahili

headline: HTDA Terminal 2 Lighting Upgrade — Night Ops Reduced 15%
body: Night-ops capacity reduced during 48-hour electrical overhaul. Standby generators operational but secondary taxiways unlit. Plan for extended ground times on late arrivals.
source: TAA Official | Translation: Original English / Translated from Swahili

headline: HKJK: Enhanced Passenger Screening — Departure Delays
body: Enhanced screening at JKIA following security advisory. Operators reporting 20–35 min ground delays on all departures. Passengers advised to arrive early. KCAA coordinating.
source: KCAA Security Bulletin | Translation: Original English

headline: Entebbe (HUEN) Runway 17/35 WIP — Reduced RESA Margin
body: Scheduled maintenance work in progress on Runway 17/35. No operational closures but pilots advised of reduced RESA margin during approach. Ref AIP Uganda AD 2-HUEN-2-1.

headline: Kigali (HRYR): CB Monitoring — Western Highlands Advisory
body: VFR conditions prevailing. Met office monitoring CB development over western highlands. No restrictions but crews advised to check updated TAF on departure.
source: Rwanda Met Service | Translation: Original English
